Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting.

Looking at my schedule for next week (Nov 23-27), the free slots I have are:
- Mon Nov 23, 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tue Nov 24, 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Wed Nov 25, 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Which of these works for you? Or tell me another slot inside Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 and I'll see if I can move something.

Hi Professor Alvarez — thanks. I checked my week (Nov 23-27):

- Mon 23rd: no — 09:50-11:00 focus block and the 14:10-15:40 seminar sit exactly on both of your slots.
- Tue 24th: **15:00-15:30 works** (the 11:00-11:30 one falls inside my 09:50-11:10 seminar).
- Wed 25th: both work — 10:00-10:30 sits between my CSE452 lecture and CSE455 office hours, and 13:00-13:30 right after lunch.

Let's take **Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30** — it runs straight into my CSE455 office hours, so it's convenient. I'm booking that; tell me if you'd rather have one of the Wednesday slots and I'll switch.

Perfect, let's take Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30. It's in my calendar now, right before my CSE455 office hours — convenient for both of us.

Agenda: let's keep it to CSE455 staffing for the rest of the quarter — TA coverage, the guest lecture slot, and the grading timeline. If you want anything added, send it over before Monday and I'll fold it in.

Thanks Sarah.

Confirmed on my side too — Tue Nov 24, 15:00-15:30, right before office hours. Agenda as you have it (TA coverage, guest lecture slot, grading timeline). One thing I'd add: quiz-section and office-hours coverage over the Thanksgiving week itself, since that's the week we're meeting in. I'll send nothing else unless something comes up. Thanks!
Good addition — Thanksgiving week's coverage goes on the agenda too. See you Tuesday the 24th at 15:00.
